prompt:
Our B2B project management SaaS tool launched 8 months ago and I need a proper revenue intelligence report before our investor check-in next week. We have three raw data exports in the workspace under data/raw_exports/ — monthly subscription events, customer profiles, and operating expenses — but nobody has analyzed them yet.

Please process all three files and produce a file called revenue_intelligence_report.json that gives us:
1. How we performed against our official MRR growth targets at each standard checkpoint month (months 1, 3, 6)
2. An honest classification of our current business health status
3. Which customers are our 'whales' vs. the rest, and what share of revenue they represent
4. Our churn situation for the last two months and whether it's crossed any danger thresholds
5. Three forward-looking revenue scenarios for next month (conservative, middle, and optimistic)
6. Our customer lifetime value efficiency relative to acquisition costs
7. Our current burn rate, break-even point, and any active red flags that need immediate attention

The report needs to use the standard industry thresholds and classification system for SaaS businesses — not just generic calculations. The investor will cross-check the milestone targets and forecast multipliers against the framework we use internally.
